versions.changelog: Composio para buscar (Tavily y Apify) con comandos exactos en f100k-puente, actores con virgulilla y reglas de evidencia

- Initial release of "analiza-tu-contenido-f100k" skill for FÓRMULA 100K.
- Automates the «Analiza tu Contenido» module using Instagram/Apify data and user-provided stats.
- Generates the La Hoja del Mes infográfica (printable HTML) for the user, including stats, transcripts, conclusions, and a detailed content calendar.
- Requires user’s Instagram handle, monthly goal, number of posts, and both basic and advanced insights (captures from phone for retention/profile metrics).
- Fully automates data handling and structuring—manual calculations and guesswork are not allowed.
- Intended for use only on the user’s own account, not third-party audits.
